planted.heading: Fees and Payment
planted.note: Payment stretched from net-30 to net-120, with instant suspension if late.

planted.heading: Term and Termination
planted.note: Auto-renewal trap: 180 days notice to escape, and only the Provider may terminate for convenience.

planted.heading: Intellectual Property
planted.note: Deliverables stay the Provider's property; the Client only gets a revocable internal-use licence.

planted.heading: Limitation of Liability
planted.note: The Client's liability is unlimited while the Provider's is capped at ten percent of three months of fees.

planted.heading: Data Protection
planted.note: No PDPA commitment and no duty to notify the Client of a data breach.
